goal: Allow developers to test blocks with multiple coinbase recipients and custom payout splits
Enable mining mempool transactions automatically in regtest without crafting raw blocks
reviewability: Ready for review following an author rebase
agreement: Strong support for simulating protocols with multiple coinbase recipients (supertestnet)
Addressed objections against creating a separate RPC and modifying core miner logic (andrewtoth, maflcko)
Addressed objections on backwards compatibility and custom reward amounts (achow101, stickies-v)

Eliminates the need to construct raw blocks manually when testing regtest mining structures
